name: Linnorm, Shoal
body:
SHOAL LINNORM
CR 15

This massive, green, serpentine dragon has a bright-red, spined fin along its back.

XP 51,200
CE Gargantuan dragon (aquatic)
Init +10; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, true seeing; Perception +22

DEFENSE

AC 30, touch 12, flat-footed 24 (+6 Dex, +18 natural, -4 size)
hp 217 (15d12+120); regeneration 10 (cold iron)
Fort +17, Ref +17, Will +13
Defensive Abilities freedom of movement; DR 15/cold iron; Immune fire, curse effects, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, sleep; SR 26

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 100 ft. (average), swim 60 ft.
Melee bite +24 (2d8+13/19-20 plus poison), 2 claws +24 (2d6+13), tail +18 (2d6+6 plus grab)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon, constrict (tail, 2d6+19), death curse

STATISTICS

Str 36, Dex 22, Con 26, Int 5, Wis 19, Cha 23
Base Atk +15; CMB +32 (+35 grapple); CMD 48 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Vital Strike
Skills Fly +23, Perception +22, Swim +39
Languages Aklo, Draconic, Sylvan
SQ amphibious

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Su)

Once every 1d4 rounds, a shoal linnorm can expel a 60-foot cone of scalding steam, dealing 15d8 points of fire damage to all creatures in the area (Reflex DC 25 for half damage). The area then becomes solid fog for 1d6 rounds, and creatures entering or beginning their turn within the area take 5d6 fire damage (Reflex save DC 25 for half damage). The save DC is Constitution-based.

Death Curse (Su)

Curse of Drowning: save Will DC 23; effect creature can never gain the benefit of water breathing, and if it possesses this ability, loses it as long as it suffers the curse. In addition, the creature can hold its breath only half as long as normal, and whenever the cursed creature holds its breath, it functions as if sickened.

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 25; frequency 1/round for 10 rounds; effect 3d6 fire damage and 1d4 Con drain; cure 2 consecutive saves.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold coastlines
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Shoal linnorms dwell along the cold coastlines of the north. They sometimes raid small fishing villages but typically avoid larger ports. However, their favored prey are large, fat rich creatures like whales, giant squid, or large bears. They metabolize the fat to power their steam-breath.

Both the curse and poison of a shoal linnorm are dangerous for those plying the fishing lanes of the north.

The shoal linnorm’s curse is particularly devastating to aquatic creatures, and such beings are careful to avoid any possible conflict with such linnorms.

A shoal linnorm is 55 feet long and weighs around 10,000 pounds.
